kind: Validation of ONE additive write-only diagnostic field the engine now publishes. No tracking, phase estimation, unwrap, threshold, F4, candidate generation, acceptance or refusal behaviour is changed. No remediation, no new estimator, no new dataset.
question: Can the engine report whether its phase tracker is operating within the assumption its own unwrap depends on, as evidence rather than as a verdict?

the_condition_and_why_it_is_the_trackers.code: src/pipeline.py::_track_phase computes per-block M-power angles `ang` and calls np.unwrap(ang). np.unwrap keeps the WRAPPED block-to-block change and assumes it is the true one. That is correct if and only if |true change| < pi. So pi is not a chosen threshold: it is the exact discriminant of the operation the shipped tracker performs.
the_condition_and_why_it_is_the_trackers.quantity: max_wrapped_advance_rad = max over blocks of |wrap(diff(ang))|, and unwrap_margin_rad = pi - that. Both are read off `ang`, which the tracker already computed. No score, no confidence, no invented threshold.
the_condition_and_why_it_is_the_trackers.what_it_cannot_do: Aliasing is intrinsic: a true advance of exactly 2*pi wraps to 0 and is indistinguishable from no advance. The margin therefore measures PROXIMITY TO THE AMBIGUITY, not the violation itself. This limitation is to be stated, not engineered around.

published_field.null_means: no tracked front end exists (the capture was too short for the tracker to run at all) -> the condition is INDETERMINATE. This is the third required state and it is computed, not assumed.
published_field.write_only: Nothing in src/ reads the field or the per-front-end unwrap_margin_rad it aggregates. No acceptance, refusal, ranking, bar or multiplicity consults it. A small margin is EVIDENCE, never a verdict, and must not be reported as 'decode failed'.

which_aggregate_is_meaningful.declared_before_the_full_sweep: A pilot on 32 captures showed min_unwrap_margin_rad reaching 0.0003 rad on STATIC controls. That is expected and is not a fault: the front-end search deliberately includes wrong-cfo and wrong-sps candidates, whose trackers SHOULD be beyond the bound. So the minimum over front ends is not a warning signal and must not be presented as one.
which_aggregate_is_meaningful.primary: max_unwrap_margin_rad — the largest headroom any tracked front end achieved, i.e. 'was ANY tracked front end operating within its unwrap assumption?'. The full sweep must confirm it separates static controls from time-varying captures.
which_aggregate_is_meaningful.both_reported: Both aggregates are published because both are facts; the report states which one answers the question and why the other does not.

validation_required: verdicts unchanged: status and code for all 192 sealed Doppler captures must equal the recorded SPACE-DOPPLER values
the diagnostic is deterministic: two runs byte-identical
the diagnostic corresponds to the actual tracker computation: the published margin must equal pi - max|wrap(diff(block_angles))| recomputed from the tracker's own trace
static controls acquire no spurious warning: their max_unwrap_margin_rad must stay clearly away from 0
sealed datasets and all previous evidence files unchanged

decision_rules.SEPARATES: static controls and time-varying captures occupy non-overlapping ranges of max_unwrap_margin_rad, and the time-varying captures known to slip sit nearest the bound.
decision_rules.DOES_NOT_SEPARATE: the ranges overlap, or static controls sit near the bound. Then the field is reported as insufficient and NO proxy is substituted.
decision_rules.no_threshold_in_production: The engine publishes the number and the bound. No cut-off is compiled in. Any banding in the report is descriptive of the measured populations, not a rule the engine applies.
decision_rules.three_states: INDETERMINATE = field is null (tracker never ran). The other two states are read off the published margin against the measured separation, in the report layer only.

constraints: Tracking, phase estimation and unwrap behaviour unchanged; no threshold, F4, serial-independence, sps ranking, candidate generation, acceptance or refusal change.
No remediation and no new estimator. A margin near zero triggers nothing.
No sealed dataset altered; no previous experiment's rows, manifests, criteria or reports regenerated, overwritten or edited to agree with this result.
If the exposed field did not separate, the report says so rather than inventing a substitute.
